name: Nova
source:
"You're going to kill me? You're going to mess me up? AHA! I LOVE THAT HATRED!"

Pain begets pleasure.

A member of the Ludens, a mysterious group of beings that suddenly appear in World's Odyssey. She is the Agent of Wrath. Her aggressive front makes her difficult to reason with. She is a masochist, deriving enjoyment from the infliction of pain.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
